brief:
The Israeli military ordered a criminal investigation Wednesday into the 2024 killing of five-year-old Hind Rajab in Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. Her death drew international outrage after a harrowing recording of her final moments circulated widely, capturing her distress as she remained trapped in a vehicle.

Hind's body was recovered from the car days after the incident. The military's decision to open a criminal probe came amid sustained global pressure and continued attention to her case. The recording of her voice in her last hours became a focal point for criticism of Israeli operations in Gaza and amplified calls for accountability regarding civilian casualties in the territory.

title: Israeli military launches criminal investigation into killing of girl Hind Rajab
